title: Welcome to Watch Later
description: Watch Later transforms scattered Instagram Reel saves into a unified, AI-categorized personal knowledge library. Let's tour the architecture across Android, Backend, and Web.

title: Android Silent Share Capture
description: ShareCaptureActivity intercepts incoming ACTION_SEND intents from Instagram with zero UI interruption, normalizing URLs via UrlHelper and enqueueing locally.

title: Room Persistence & WorkManager Sync
description: Saved reels are stored in Room database (LocalReel & ReelDao) and synced via ReelSyncWorker with exponential backoff and network monitoring.

title: Cloudflare Serverless Edge Worker
description: Backend worker ingests reel URLs, coordinates authentication with Supabase, triggers metadata extraction, and publishes real-time alerts.

title: Kinetic Landing Page & Interactive Showcase
description: ServiceLandingPage delivers a bespoke showcase with WebGL fluid cursor interaction (SplashCursor), interactive Reel dashboard preview, and native launch video playback.

title: Swift Video Rendering Pipelines
description: Native AVFoundation Swift scripts render 60fps cinematic launch videos with typography and scene motion directly from project assets.
